articles.title: A Critical Analysis of Legal and Human Rights of Undertrial Female Prisoners in India
articles.abstract: An empirical socio-legal analysis reviewing statutory protections, prison conditions, judicial precedents, and systemic vulnerabilities confronting female undertrial detainees.

articles.title: Decline and Fall: Factors Contributing to the Downfall of the Mughal Empire
articles.abstract: A historiographical reassessment of the fiscal strains, agrarian distress, regional rebellions, and administrative fragmentation that precipitated the decline of the Mughal Empire in 18th-century South Asia.

articles.title: The Dynamics of Indian Nationalism: A Historical Analysis Age
articles.abstract: A critical historical investigation exploring the multifaceted evolutionary trajectories, subaltern voices, and ideological currents that shaped the anti-colonial nationalist movement in India.
